title: My First Mobile Game!
author: OGZamasu
selftext:
I'm excited to share that I finished and published my first mobile game with the help of Claude. It's about my friend who always has to finish his chores before he gets on discord to hang out with his friends. I had a lot of fun with this. The process of getting approved and published is a bit more than I had anticipated at first, but after about a month of waiting I got it! 

I made this game with Opus 4.8. But now we have Opus 5.5 and I cannot wait to make something cool with it. This was a big step in me learning what modern AI tools are capable of. I'm really enjoying it. 

I'd love to see some of your apps and games that you guys have shipped. for me this is a big milestone. It's free, no ads or purchases. just something fun for my first published game.
